name: Remote hire
description: The standard steps, plus a remote work agreement, equipment shipped before day one and a video welcome.
welcome_message: We are delighted that you are joining us. Before your first day, please complete the steps below so everything is ready when you arrive. If anything is unclear, reply to your invitation email or ask your manager.
first_day_info: Your first day starts with a video call with your manager. The link is in your calendar invitation.

config.text: Start here: this checklist covers everything we need before your first day. It takes about 20 minutes. You can come back to it at any time.

Open Personal Details in the menu (under About You) and check your name, date of birth, contact details and address. Correct anything that is missing or out of date. Then open Emergency Contacts and add at least one person we can call in an emergency. Give HR your bank details for your salary. If you like, add a short note about yourself so the team can get to know you.

steps.title: Check the new hire's profile
steps.instructions: Check that personal details, contact details and emergency contacts are complete. Add the bank details to payroll.

steps.title: Upload a copy of your ID
steps.instructions: Upload your passport or national identity card. Bring the original on your first day.

config.text: I have read the company's code of conduct and I agree to follow it.
I have read the IT acceptable use policy. I will use company systems, devices and accounts only as it allows, keep my passwords private and report anything suspicious to IT.
I have read the employee privacy notice, which explains what personal data the company keeps about me, why, and how long it is kept.
I have read the remote work policy. I will keep a safe and private place to work, protect company information at home, and be reachable during my agreed working hours.

steps.title: Agree the equipment the new hire needs
steps.instructions: Ask the new hire what they need to work from home (laptop, screen, headset, chair) and arrange it.

config.text: Your laptop is shipped to your home address before your start date. On day one, join the welcome call, set up multi-factor sign-in and meet your team online.

steps.title: Ship the laptop and equipment
steps.instructions: Ship to the home address in their profile so it arrives before the start date.

steps.title: Send the signed contract and offer letter
steps.instructions: Make sure the signed contract is on file before the start date.

steps.title: Set up payroll and benefits
steps.instructions: Add the new hire to payroll with their bank and tax details once they have given them to you.

steps.title: Create email and system accounts
steps.instructions: Create the email account, single sign-on and access to chat and the HR system. Assign this task to your IT contact if you have one.

steps.title: Plan the first week
steps.instructions: Agree meetings, introductions and a first piece of work.

steps.title: Introduce the buddy and the team
90-day review
steps.instructions: Review progress against the goals and decide on the end of probation if it applies.

steps.title: Video coffee with the new hire in week one
